neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused, a man, was alleged by a woman to have had sexual relations with her on assurance of marriage on several dates in 2006–2007, and to have misbehaved with her on 15.2.2007 after giving her a Pepsi allegedly containing an intoxicant. An FIR was registered and the accused was arrested and later granted bail. A charge-sheet was filed and charges were framed. Mobile phone records placed both parties elsewhere on 15.2.2007. The complainant had been married during the alleged occurrences. Medical examination showed no external injuries and no evidence of poisoning.
neutral_facts.quote: The High Court quashed the criminal proceedings due to lack of credible evidence
neutral_facts.reason: High Court did not quash proceedings; the summary also reveals the court's outcome and misstates the 15.2.2007 allegation as intercourse.

offence_severity.quote: invites a minimum punishment of 07 years
offence_severity.reason: The High Court noted s.376 IPC invites a minimum punishment of 7 years.

attempt_completion.reason: Completed intercourse is alleged in the supplementary statement; no attempt is claimed for those dates.
